hypotheses.B0_local_jacobian_predicts_logit_directi: Median Fisher cosine between Jacobian-predicted and finite graph-replacement logit effects is at least 0.90 on every corpus.
hypotheses.B1_fisher_energy_ranks_finite_kl: Spearman correlation between local Fisher energy and finite KL is at least 0.80 on every corpus.
hypotheses.B2_top_decile_localizes_error: The 10% of sites with largest predicted Fisher energy contain at least 50% of total finite KL on every corpus.
hypotheses.B3_predicted_margin_identifies_top1_flip: The predicted post-edit top1 margin score has AUROC at least 0.85 for finite top1 flips on every corpus.
hypotheses.B4_output_geometry_beats_hidden_norm: Fisher-energy versus KL Spearman exceeds hidden-delta-norm versus KL Spearman by at least 0.20 on every corpus.
hypotheses.B5_second_order_scale_is_calibrated: Median finite KL divided by one-half Fisher variance lies between 0.5 and 2.0 on every corpus.
